title: new family members join me at my secluded forest home - springtime blessings
en: there is still quite a bit of snow on the ground despite the first days of spring that I can sense my little Valley is starting to wake up after five sleepy months of snow and ice the warmth in the air couldn't be more welcomed and despite the mud on my boots I'm in High Spirits and anticipating the first spring flowers I still have a while to wait but the new season is moving in the air has shifted smells of fresh soil and saplings permeate the forest thank you

this is a time of great change in my quiet secluded life I have great plans of future gardening projects hiking on Trails newly uncovered and as promised the announcement of some new additions to my animal family wood was full of rabbit holes and in the neatest sandiest told the ball lived Benjamin's aunt and his cousins flopsy mopsy Cottontail and Peter old Mrs rabbit was a widow she earned her living by knitting rabbit wool mittens and muffets I once bought a pair at a Bazaar she also sold herbs and rosemary tea and rabbit tobacco which is what we call lavender Bernard two sweet little rabbits that have recently found their way into my life once they're old enough they will be living together in a little rabbit dwelling my husband and I are building in the spring in the meantime they're

getting used to all the new smells and sounds of the cottage safely tucked away in a little indoor Hutch they're already bringing me great joy adding a new vibrancy into my cold and snowy world I recently decided to make a little porch Garden of herbs and flowers and a vegetable garden in front of my home with great plans to grow more mint and chamomile for tea I used to dislike this time of year somewhere between winter and spring when all you see is mud and dead grass mixed in with melting snow and yet now I like to see it as a necessary time as we all must accept seasons of scarcity in order to truly enjoy the abundance that is yet to come cloudy and dark days are perhaps not so bad as we think because they always give way to something beautiful if we are only patient I think I still have mud on me it is so swampy and wet outside but I have to admit I'm really enjoying it because I am so ready for spring it's been I think almost five months of snow and that is a much longer winter than we're used to and so I just I just I'm impatient but I'm trying to be patient so yes we did

invite two lovely new bunnies to come live with us Luke and I are gonna work on building a wonderful outdoor Sanctuary for them for the spring and if you happen to know where the names Bianca and Bernard come from do let me know it is one of my favorite sets of movies so of course there is a lot of change on the horizon change of seasons new bunnies new things to build around the house sales from my Etsy shop this week will be helping go towards building Bernard and Bianca's new outdoor Sanctuary hopefully it can be a place to bring rescued rabbits in the future as well and so I have big plans rabbits have always been one of my favorite types of animals I think that they are so sweet and so deeply affected by their environment if they're in a chaotic and Loud environment it is quite difficult for them to thrive and they really crave peace and nature and quietness and I feel like our souls are quite similar in that way so I'm a huge fan of bunnies and I'm so happy to have more in my life if flowers are blooming and things are bright and blue where you are that is so wonderful please send some of that lovely warmth and Magic over here but the snow will be melted soon I am sure sending all my love I will see you very soon
zh: 尽管春天的第一天，我能感觉到我的小山谷在经历了五个月的冰雪沉睡后开始苏醒，但地面上仍然有很多雪，空气中的温暖是再好不过了，尽管我的靴子上沾满了泥，我还是兴高采烈，期待着春天的第一朵花，我还有一段时间等待，但新的季节正在空气中移动，新鲜土壤的气味已经改变，树苗弥漫在森林里，谢谢

这是我安静隐居生活中发生巨大变化的时刻，我对未来的园艺项目有一个伟大的计划，在新发现的小径上徒步旅行，正如所承诺的，我的动物家族的一些新成员的宣布，树林里充满了兔子洞，在最整洁的沙子里，告诉舞会住着本杰明的姨妈和他的表兄弟，软绵绵的棉尾和彼得老兔子夫人是一个寡妇，她靠编织兔毛手套和手铐谋生，我曾经在一家商店买过一双。她还卖香草、迷迭香茶和兔子烟草，也就是我们所说的薰衣草伯纳德两只可爱的小兔子最近进入了我的生活，一旦它们足够大，它们就会一起住在我和我丈夫在春天建造的小兔子屋里，同时它们也在

习惯了安全地藏在一个小室内小屋里的小屋的所有新气味和声音，它们已经给我带来了巨大的快乐，为我寒冷多雪的世界增添了新的活力，我最近决定在我家前面建一个小门廊，种上香草和鲜花的花园，在我家前面建一个菜园，计划种植更多的薄荷和洋甘菊来泡茶。把它看作是一个必要的时刻，因为我们所有人都必须接受匮乏的季节，以便真正享受即将到来的丰富，阴天和黑暗的日子也许并不像我们想象的那么糟糕，因为只要我们有耐心，它们总会让位于美丽的东西，我想我身上仍然有泥，外面是如此沼泽和潮湿，但我必须承认我真的很享受它，因为我已经为春天做好了准备，我想已经下了将近五个月的雪，这是一个比我们习惯的更长的冬天，所以我只是我只是不耐烦，但我试着保持耐心，所以是的，我们做到了

邀请两只可爱的新兔子来和我们一起住卢克和我要为他们建造一个美妙的春天户外避难所，如果你碰巧知道比安卡和伯纳德的名字从哪里来，请告诉我这是我最喜欢的电影之一，所以当然，地平线上会有很多变化季节的变化新兔子围绕我的 Etsy 商店的房屋销售建立的新东西将帮助建造伯纳德和比安卡的新户外庇护所希望将来它也能成为一个接收获救兔子的地方，所以我有一个宏伟的计划，兔子一直是我最喜欢的动物类型之一，我认为它们是如此可爱，并且深受环境影响，如果它们处于混乱和喧闹的环境中，它们很难茁壮成长，它们真的渴望和平、自然和安静，我觉得我们的灵魂在这方面非常相似，所以我是兔子的超级粉丝，我很高兴能拥有更多在我的生命中，如果鲜花盛开，一切都明亮而蓝色，你在的地方，那真是太棒了，请送一些可爱的温暖和魔法到这里，但雪很快就会融化，我相信送出我所有的爱，我很快就会见到你
